name: Zabbix Alert Webhook
description: Zabbix media type webhook for problem and recovery notifications, with stable host IDs and severity mapping.

configFields.label: Webhook receiver token
configFields.help: At least 32 unpredictable characters. Use the same token in the Zabbix media type.

configFields.label: Treat high/disaster as offline
configFields.help: Off by default: a severe problem does not necessarily mean a device is offline.
